name: Tokyo Conspiration
source:
The Kizuna satellite from Jaxa, Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency, promises to give Asia a 1.2 Gbps bandwidth connection, anywhere and anytime. Be BiFrost, one of the biggest hackers in the world, and help a strange guy who seeks the development secrets of the Project Kizuna.

[From Ren'Py wiki]
